column1: # kr_view_casts.tsv (3.44 T6): a callee whose short calls go through KR_AS(T, fn) (include/common.h); one row per callee, keyed exactly; def_file = the callee's definition (its one prototype is the definition's; T = that definition's return); cause = the byte evidence that the shipped callers passed fewer arguments than the callee reads; task = the task that ledgered it; cites = `<binary>:0x<vaddr> <insn>` items, `; `-separated, as tools/sig_evidence.py cite() prints them: the callee's read of the missing argument register or slot and one short caller's jal; verified by sig_evidence.py --check (docs/ops/sig-evidence.md "## Unprototyped views (3.44 T6)").
